def find_triples(n):
    from itertools import permutations
    target_set = set(range(1, 3*n + 1))
    possible_differences = {n-1, n, n+1}
    for perm in permutations(target_set):
        triples = [(perm[i], perm[i+1], perm[i+2]) for i in range(0, len(perm), 3)]
        if all({abs(triple[1] - triple[0]), abs(triple[2] - triple[1])} <= possible_differences for triple in triples):
            return triples
    return None
